title: Find out whether moving a layer that sits under another draws it on top until you let go
goal: While a layer is dragged, the canvas floats a copy of it over a picture of everything else, so a layer that sits under another may be drawn over it for the whole drag and drop back under on release. Seen for a turn (now fixed by redrawing per move); not yet confirmed for a move.
notes: Evidence (2026-10-12, rotating-a-layer-that-already-has-a-transform-up): before turns were moved off the sprite, turning the recording (Tutorial Sample) with rectangles above it showed the turned recording sprite covering every rectangle in the held picture (/tmp held/landed picture pair, 9.1% of canvas differed). The sprite is DragPreview: underlay = render(hiding: id), sprite = renderSprite(for: id), previewSpriteLayer sits above contentLayer (EditorState.beginLayerDrag, CanvasDisplay.refreshPreviewSprite), so moves use the same arrangement. Reproduction attempt for a MOVE: blank 1200x800, rectangle then ellipse overlapping, drag the rectangle with hold; inconclusive because both shapes drew in the same red. Retry with a second fill colour.
acceptance: A walk moves a layer that sits partly under a different coloured layer and photographs it mid-drag with the button down
If the lower layer is drawn on top mid-drag, the move keeps it under (or redraws per move) and the mid-drag picture matches the released one under 1% (spaceHandle-style landsAsHeld check)

log.note: Reproduced: new walk a-moved-layer-stays-under-what-covers-it-walk (drag gained landsAsHeld) moved a red rectangle under a crimson ellipse; held vs landed differed 5.6%, and measuring the two pictures showed identical positions with only the stacking different (rectangle drawn over the ellipse mid-drag).

Fixed: PhotonzCore DragStackSplit cuts the stack at the dragged layer; DragPreview carries an overlay of what is drawn over it, floated over the sprite in previewOverlayLayer (CanvasDisplay.showPreviewOverlay). Stacks it cannot cut faithfully (normal-blend-only, no backdrop readers, not in space, nested pieces with something over them) re-render per move. Region content moves get the same overlay. Perf: one extra async render at drag start when something is over the layer; per-move cost unchanged (pure CA). After: 0.23% (control top-layer drag 0.22%, edge antialiasing).

left rough: the lifted-pixels (region move) overlay is not covered by a walk; my attempt on the 2x fixture missed the region because the canvas is larger than the view. Not filed: nothing seen broken. Ten neighbouring drag walks green; Scripts/test.sh 13153 tests green.

Confirmed for a move (5.6% of the canvas jumped on release: the lower layer drew over the one covering it mid-drag) and fixed: the drag preview now floats what is drawn over the layer above its sprite (DragStackSplit + previewOverlayLayer); held vs landed now 0.23%. Proven by a-moved-layer-stays-under-what-covers-it-walk at Next defaults (drag gained landsAsHeld), ten neighbouring drag walks green, Scripts/test.sh 13153 green.
